pairing_contract.rule: one series per axis · left axis vs right axis over a shared X · the two series always use two different mark forms
pairing_contract.series_color_note: Spec token palette verbatim per operator directive (--blue / --teal). Known conflict, recorded for operator review: blue x teal normal-vision separation dE 10.9 (< 15 guideline; amber --am would give 24.8). Mitigated by the mandatory mark-form difference, per-series tinted axes, and direct end labels, so identity is never colour-alone.
clarity: axis domain must fully cover data extremes
pairing_contract.output_policy: Products are written under <Base>/VAP/output only; VDF database and canonical trees are read-only to the engine.
